## Projects

- [Selegic CRM](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/selegic-crm.md): multi-tenant CRM platform. Designed it, built v1 on his own and now leads the team that builds it. Pre-release, in pilot with industry users.
- [Migrata](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/migrata.md): automated multi-org Salesforce data migration platform in Node.js that replaced manual CPQ deployments. He built the platform. Released on Salesforce AppExchange.
- [Selegic Internal](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/selegic-internal.md): the company's time-tracking and project platform, built end to end and used daily at Selegic. Released.
- [Doc Gen](https://rijudevx.github.io/work/doc-gen.md): templates rendered to DOCX and PDF. He worked on its infrastructure, deployment and CPQ terms rendering. Released.

## Work

Backend-focused full stack work in TypeScript, Node.js, Hono, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare Workers, React, TanStack, Prisma, Docker and GitHub Actions. Earlier work included native iOS apps in Swift and Salesforce tools in Angular and Node.js.
